ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central pixels contrasted against low-intensity black peripheral pixels; estimated 80:20 intensity ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white regions occupy the majority of both lobes; dark low-intensity border mapping along the trailing edges; distinct mid-intensity yellowish-brown pigment clusters located on the mid-left lobe and adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation; interior pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees; vertex depth is roughly 18% of the visible vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-6 pixel height) along the distal third of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge exhibits smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge from notch to tip; distal tips show a slight posterior curvature.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-brown tan-colored discoloration clusters on the ventral left lobe surface and near the peduncle-notch interface; irregular jagged notches on the distal trailing edges.
